data.gender_notes: Nayak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Marathi culture, Nayak refers to a hero, a leader, or a commander. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nayaka' which means 'one who leads' or 'one who has authority'. The name Nayak carries the meaning “Hero, Commander” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Marathi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nayak usually hope their child will grow to embody hero, commander and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of courage and leadership in spiritual and mythological contexts.
data.etymology: Nayak belongs to the Marathi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hero, Commander.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nayak total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
